svg.text: Lock file: hash every leaf of the tree

g.text: ""I depend on library A"——" — install takes the latest A at install time.
Installed today it is 1.2, next month 2.0 (interface changed).
Two machines install two different worlds;
""it runs on my machine"" becomes an unsolvable mystery.
Every leaf records: exact version + content hash.
The hash is verified at install —— — mismatch means refusal.
Any machine, any time, the same tree.
The hash also guards against tampering: a compromised upstream is caught.

svg.text: The lock file turns "reproducibility" from a wish into a check—— — the essential difference from a "requirements requirements list": a list records names; a lock file records fingerprints.
